images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Image 1 is the existing casual spider-gothic outfit illustration of Blaise, an ADULT woman. Image 2 is the EXACT cute flat spider HAIR CLIP design to apply, round-3 option 17 (Sleepy eyes).
Change ONLY THE HAIR CLIP on Blaise's existing temple (viewer-right): replace the existing clip with the emblem from image 2, preserving its round body, eight short outlined loop legs, and small pink bow at upper right. PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE from image 1: exact face, short ivory/pink-tinted bob and bangs, red eyes, current smile, adult age, slim 80 cm reference bust/body proportions, pose, full-body framing, fingers, footwear, clothing, spiderweb fabric motifs, pendant/neck ribbon and any academy crest. The black casual top, skirt, opaque tights and boots must retain their original colors. White/black applies ONLY to the spider charm, NOT hair, clothes, skin, eyes, background, or the pendant.
Keep Zomb cel rendering, thin muted contours, restrained matte shading, fine character CRT lines and subtle red/cyan contour ghosting. Neutral gray review backdrop unchanged, no scene decoration, no stars, no text, labels or watermark. Output one full-body character image, not a collage or accessory-only icon.
